title: How overstuffing makes your hiring slower, not faster
summary: Hiring more isn’t hiring smarter. Instawork helps recruiters end funnel overload with reliable candidates who show up—faster, cheaper, and ready to work.
body_markdown:
When faced with no-shows and turnover, most recruiters try to fix the problem by doubling the funnel: more resumes, more interviews, more candidates in the pipeline. On paper, it feels logical—if half of candidates won’t show, just schedule twice as many.


‍


But in practice, overstuffing only makes things worse:


- More sourcing spend: Sourcers pay to attract twice as many applicants, most of whom won’t make it past the first step.
- Lost recruiter hours: Twice as many candidates means 100% more time a recruiter needs to spend on screenings, scheduling, and chasing candidates who never show.
- Manager disruptions: Managers block off interview slots that end up empty, pulling them away from operations.


‍


Instead of filling roles faster, timelines stretch longer. Screening 50 candidates to get the same 20 hires takes more effort, more budget, and more time.


‍


The smarter play? Start with candidates who’ve already proven they’ll show up.


‍


Instawork has solved reliability for years in temporary staffing, with millions of shifts worked with verified workers who arrive on time. Now we’ve brought that same model to hiring.


‍


The result is a 90%+ interview attendance rate, compared to an industry plagued by no-shows. That means:


✅ Less time and money sourcing


✅ No wasted interview slots


✅ Faster decisions and offers


✅ Managers can focus on the business


‍


One employer recently saw how powerful this approach can be. After posting interviews on a Friday, they met with candidates the following Wednesday and extended an offer the very next day. A role that might have stayed open for weeks from unqualified applicants and no-shows was filled in just six days because qualified candidates showed up, ready to work.


‍
